mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the skies are clear over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 38 degrees. Under the waning crescent moon, we are looking at an overnight low of 32 degrees with no rain predicted for the rest of the night.

For city updates, please note that pavement repair work is scheduled for November 10 and 11 near Morningside Boulevard and several residential streets. Also, the Plan Commission will be reviewing development projects, including the Liberty Business Park, at their upcoming meeting on December 7.

We have a busy schedule of entertainment starting with live music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can check out live music at Lake Lou-ee, the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square, or catch the music series at Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man who had been stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for quite some time, ultimately leading to his arrest for O W I.
It is a great day to stop by for today's flavor, which is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
